name: Klingspor's Woodworking Shop
old_description: Updated weekly! Don't miss another sale - sign up for our email now.
about:
Klingspor's Woodworking Shop operates a retail location in Hickory, North Carolina, at 856 21st Street Drive SE. The business was founded in 1999 and serves as a specialty store for woodworking tools, supplies, and education. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop stocks a wide range of woodworking products including abrasives (sandpaper, sanding discs, belts, and pads), router and saw bits, blades, carving and turning tools, cabinet-making supplies, finishing products, hardware, power tools, dust collection equipment, sharpening stones, safety gear, and both common and exotic woods. In addition to retail sales, the Hickory store hosts in-store woodworking classes led by staff and guest instructors, catering to all skill levels. The facility also provides meeting space for several regional woodworking clubs.

The customer base spans hobbyists, professional woodworkers, woodturners, carvers, and pyrography artists. Clubs that meet at the store include the Southeastern Pyrography Association, the North Carolina Woodturners Association (a chapter of the American Association of Woodturners), the Catawba Valley Woodcarvers, and the Western Piedmont Woodcrafters. These groups draw members from across North Carolina and neighboring states.

The company emphasizes weekly updated specials and a community-focused approach, combining product sales with hands-on learning and club gatherings. No specific founding mission or differentiator beyond this retail-and-education model is stated.
